podcast.title: Nick McCarthy's Post-Embryo Band
podcast.body: After his time with Embryo, Nick McCarthy joined this German jazz band as a bass player before moving back to Glasgow in 2001. "He eventually joined a German jazz band called Scatter on Bass before he decided to move back to Glasgow in 2001."

xref.title: Cultural Significance of Scatology
xref.body: Mozart's use of scatological humor in his compositions and letters provides insight into his sense of humor and that of his contemporaries, reinforcing the idea that such humor was more mainstream in 18th-century polite society and contributing to the field of scatter linguistics. "it reinforces the thinking that scatter logical humor was way more mainstream back then, including in polite society than it is today."

xref.title: Uncertain Fate of Ashes
xref.body: After his body was cremated, the exact whereabouts of Sid Vicious's ashes remain unclear. One account suggests his mother climbed a fence at King David Cemetery in Philadelphia to scatter them over Nancy Spungen's grave, against the wishes of Nancy's family. Another rumor claims his mother dropped the vase containing the ashes upon disembarking a plane at Heathrow Airport, leading to speculation that they are now trapped in the airport's air conditioning ducts. "His body was cremated. But the whereabouts of his ashes remain unclear."
